environment.description: Same Spring Boot application on ECS Fargate behind AWS ALB, but fronted by Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API type) acting as the public entry point. The API Gateway has a request model validation configured on the POST /api/v2/diagnostics/network-check route with 'validateRequestBody: true'. The JSON schema model enforces: 'tool' must be enum ['ping','traceroute','nslookup'], 'target' must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9.:-]{1,253}$ with type string and maxLength 253, and 'options' field is NOT defined in the schema (additionalProperties: false). Any request containing an 'options' field or a tool/target value not matching the schema receives a 400 from API Gateway before reaching the ALB. The API Gateway route integrates with the ALB via VPC Link (private integration).

config.api_gateway: Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with VPC Link integration to internal ALB
config.network: API Gateway -> VPC Link -> internal ALB (not publicly accessible) -> ECS tasks
config.alb_access: Security group allows inbound only from VPC Link ENIs, not from internet
